children: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited (“the Bank”) (BSX: NTB.BH) (NYSE: NTB) announced the results of the Shareholders’ vote at the Bank’s Annual General Meeting held in virtual format today (September 18, 2026).

Each of the proposals numbered 1 through 4 on the Meeting Agenda was approved by the requisite vote. Proposal 5, which sought authority to adjourn or postpone the Meeting if there were insufficient votes to approve Proposal 4, was not necessary and was therefore not presented for a vote.

Butterfield is a full-service bank and wealth manager headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda. Our principal banking operations are located in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey and Jersey, providing deposit, cash management and lending solutions for individual, business and institutional clients. We provide a full range of wealth management services, comprising trust, private banking, asset management and custody, in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands and Guernsey, trust services in The Bahamas, Singapore and Switzerland, and residential property lending in the UK.
